verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes a public REST API with developer guides, so an agent-oriented docs index is a fair question for it. However, the only direct probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at gov.uk/llms.txt), and nothing in the pack documents agent-oriented documentation. The keyless GOV.UK Content API and the conventional developer guides are adjacent machine-readable resources, not llms.txt or agent-targeted docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
